definitions: A location in J.R.R. Tolkien's fictional world of Middle-earth, specifically a village in Buckland, a region of the Shire.
The easternmost village of Buckland, known for being near the Old Forest.
examples: Frodo Baggins and his companions stayed at a house in Crickhollow before entering the Old Forest.
The Brandywine Bridge is not far from Crickhollow.
